title: Acts and Ordinances of the Interregnum
institution: Institute of Historical Research (British History Online)
notes: The full text of the legislation passed into law during the Interregnum (1642-1660), over 900 acts and ordinances, from the edition by C. H. Firth and R. S. Rait (London, 1911, three volumes). British History Online presents the three volumes together, with tables of acts for each year and the editors' introduction. The text was digitised by double rekeying and is free to read on the site. British History Online is a not-for-profit digital library run by the Institute of Historical Research, University of London. Corpus statistics (text, word and language counts, period) derived from the Renascor Corpus snapshot v2026.10 (texts harvested from this edition, duplicates included; they may cover only part of it).
